description: The binary the public installer last installed, written atomically to station/installed.json under the state root at the end of a successful install that installed a station binary, so a client finds station before any engine has started. A platform with no station build gets spwn alone, exits 0 and writes no record; an older record is left byte for byte and never deleted. An install path with a control character (below 0x20, or 0x7f) is refused before any write. The state root is $XDG_STATE_HOME when it is an absolute path, else $HOME/.local/state. The shape is engine.Record's, written by make generate; install.json says where.
title: station.install-record/v1
